limitations_and_boundaries: Generalization is limited to drugs within the chemical space covered by the training data.
The sci-Plex3 dataset contains fewer than 200 drugs, limiting the breadth of chemical interactions learned.
Technological noise in single-cell data may hinder performance on extended gene sets without pretraining.
The uncertainty measure relies on MoA prediction from KNN-graph, which may be imperfect for drugs with novel mechanisms.

research_questions.statement: Can a model predict single-cell transcriptomic responses to unseen drug perturbations by leveraging molecular structure and bulk RNA HTS data?

provenance.text_excerpt: the pretrained model shows the best performance.

claims.statement: Pretraining on bulk RNA HTS data improves chemCPA's generalization to unseen drugs.

provenance.text_excerpt: the uncertainty score u for unseen drugs correlates well with the accurate prediction of perturbed cells.

claims.statement: The uncertainty score correlates with chemCPA's generalization ability to unseen drugs.

provenance.text_excerpt: chemCPA outperforms existing methods on the task of predicting unobserved drug-covariate combinations.

claims.statement: chemCPA outperforms existing methods on predicting unobserved drug-covariate combinations.

datasets.description: Single-cell RNA-seq perturbation screen with 188 drugs, three cell lines (A549, K562, MCF7), and multiple dosages. Nine test drugs: Dacinostat, Givinostat, Belinostat, Hesperadin, Quisinostat, Alvespimycin, Tanespimycin, TAK-901, Flavopiridol.
datasets.name: sci-Plex3
datasets.version_or_split: three splits with held-out drug-cell line combinations

datasets.description: Bulk RNA HTS dataset from the LINCS program used for pretraining chemCPA.
datasets.name: L1000
datasets.version_or_split: subset to 977 genes shared with sci-Plex3

experiments_or_tasks: Assess transfer learning from bulk L1000 data to single-cell data.
Evaluate generalization to unseen drugs using shared and extended gene sets.
Measure uncertainty of drug embeddings to indicate generalization reliability.
Predict counterfactual gene expression for unseen drug-covariate combinations on sci-Plex3 single-cell data.

methods.name: chemCPA
methods.protocol_description: Encoder-decoder architecture with a perturbation network that encodes drug molecular structure. Uses a compositional latent space where basal state is disentangled from perturbation attributes. Pretrained on bulk L1000 data via architecture surgery, then fine-tuned on sci-Plex3. Hyperparameters optimized via random search (10 samples).

methods.name: CPA
methods.protocol_description: Compositional Perturbation Autoencoder; baseline method that does not generalize to unseen drugs. Optimized identically to chemCPA with same hyperparameter sweep.

methods.name: scGen
methods.protocol_description: Baseline model that predicts perturbation responses but cannot distinguish dosages. Optimized with default parameters and adjusted KL annealing to match epoch count.

methods.name: Baseline
methods.protocol_description: Model that discards all perturbation information, serving as a lower bound.

study_units.name: chemCPA model development and evaluation
